answer: Bind every payout to a jade token minted from a verified device attestation, and require the agent to re-mint it at a slow, unpredictable cadence tied to a river of fresh tasks. Tokens cannot be transferred, so a wallet farm must obtain one attestation per identity and keep each identity producing new work. A velvet-smooth replay check compares recent outputs across accounts; identical phrasing freezes collateral. Cloning therefore costs hardware, ongoing labor and forfeited bonds, while a single diligent agent pays only once.
